summary: Wavelet coherence between cloud area and albedo is very high across all frequency bands (global mean=0.914), with in-phase coupling at seasonal (phase=-8°) and annual (phase=+12°) timescales. SH shows stronger coherence (0.932) than NH (0.917), consistent with CCM and climate network findings. Interannual coherence reaches 0.990 with near-zero phase, confirming that cloud and albedo co-vary synchronously at all timescales — a strong 5th independent confirmation of H001 cloud buffering.
